A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organizations around the world use data. As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll have an opportunity to grow more quickly than you ever envisioned, as you contribute high-quality code directly to Palantir Gotham, Palantir Foundry, or Palantir Apollo: products that are deployed at some of the most important institutions across the public and private sectors. You'll create features used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world. Palantir's Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers, each focusing on a specific aspect of a product. For example, you might join a team that builds a Foundry front-end application, or a component of the Gotham release infrastructure. We encourage communication and collaboration among teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different aspects of each product.

Core Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer, you are involved throughout the product lifecycle - from idea generation, design, and prototyping to execution and shipping while also being paired with a mentor dedicated to your growth and success. You'll collaborate closely with technical and non-technical counterparts to understand our customers' problems and build products that tackle them. One of the most effective ways to understand what our users need is to meet them. You may receive an opportunity to tour the assembly line at an auto-manufacturer or join a counter-terror analyst at their desk to really understand their mission and difficulties.

SWE principles include:

• Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end in spite of obstacles we may encounter.

• Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers and Product Reliability Engineers. We also partner with our business development teams (Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Strategists) in order to understand and solve our customers' problems.

• Trust: We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities, and don't micromanage. We want people to have the space to think for themselves, while feeling supported by their team.

Technologies We Use

It doesn’t matter what languages you know when you join us, but it does matter that you can write clean, effective code and learn new languages quickly. Our software is constantly evolving, so we need engineers who can do the same. Alongside peers that bring diverse experience - whether you’re a former university TA, switched to CS recently, or are a hackathon enthusiast — you'll build your skills to apply the best technology to solve a given problem. Right now, we use:

• Varying languages, including Java and Go for backend and Typescript for frontend

• Open-source technologies like Cassandra, Spark, Elasticsearch, React, and Redux

• Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

What We Value

- Ability to communicate and collaborate with a variety of individuals, including engineers, users and non-technical team members.

- Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed.

- Active US Security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance.

What We Require

- Engineering background in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, and Physics.

- Familiarity with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.

- Experience coding in programming languages, such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.

- Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.

To apply, please submit the following:

- An updated resume / CV - please do so in PDF format.

- Thoughtful responses to our application questions.

Salary

The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,500/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Life at Palantir

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

If you would like to understand more about how your personal data will be processed by Palantir, please see our Privacy Policy.

Apply early for priority consideration. Gallup has limited openings for this internship, and the position will be filled quickly.

As an AI/ML research intern at Gallup, you’ll investigate important technical questions at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning and behavioral science. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you’ll design experiments, evaluate new models and methods, build prototypes, and help determine which emerging AI approaches are worth applying to Gallup’s products and AI systems.

You’ll work in a unique environment where Gallup’s behavioral science, proprietary data and decades of research meet rapidly advancing AI technology. Your work will influence real systems designed to help people and organizations make better decisions.

What You’ll Do

During your internship, you will:

- Research advances in AI and machine learning, reproduce promising approaches and evaluate whether they meaningfully improve on existing methods

- Design and contribute to experiments and prototypes that test new approaches to AI systems, applied machine learning and AI-enabled products

- Investigate technical questions involving AI systems, retrieval and knowledge systems, model evaluation, machine learning, and other areas relevant to Gallup’s AI research

- Turn research questions into hypotheses, experiments, measurable results and technical recommendations

- Analyze experimental results, identify limitations and unexpected findings, and clearly communicate what the evidence supports

- Evaluate new models, methods and tools through benchmarks, experiments and hands-on implementation

- Document methods, results and recommendations so other researchers and engineers can reproduce and build on your work

- Collaborate closely with AI researchers, engineers and other technical partners as new capabilities move from research into real systems

What You Need

- Enrollment in a bachelor’s or graduate degree program in computer science, data science, machine learning or a related quantitative field required

- Programming experience relevant to machine learning or data science, including Python, required

- Hands-on experience building, training, evaluating or experimenting with machine learning or AI systems through research, coursework or substantial independent projects required

- Experience designing experiments, analyzing quantitative results or evaluating machine learning systems preferred

- Familiarity with modern machine learning frameworks and techniques, such as PyTorch, transformer models, retrieval systems or model evaluation, preferred

- Previous research experience, publications, open-source contributions or technically substantial independent projects are a plus

- Enrollment at a college or university within an 80-mile radius of San Francisco, California, required

- Anticipated graduation between August 2027 and May 2028 preferred; will consider 2029 graduates

- Availability to work 40 hours per week for 12 weeks during the summer of 2027 required

- A commitment to working on-site at Gallup’s San Francisco office Monday through Thursday required, with the option to work remotely on Friday

- Eligibility to work in the United States required; this position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship

What We Offer

- A full-time summer 2027 internship that pays $45 to $50 per hour

- The potential to work up to 20 hours per week during the school year, depending on business demands

- The potential for a full-time job offer upon graduation, based on Gallup’s business needs and intern performance

What You’ll Experience

- Mission-driven work: Make a meaningful difference in the world through work that applies science and technology to important human and organizational problems.

- An empowering culture: Collaborate with smart, passionate people who welcome your ideas, perspectives and technical judgment.

- Learning and development: Grow your skills through hands-on research, experimentation and exposure to AI systems, extensive data and engineering challenges.

- Room to challenge assumptions: Work in an environment where curiosity, rigorous thinking and questioning existing approaches are expected.

- Brand strength, startup energy: Work on emerging technology in a fast-moving environment backed by Gallup’s research, science and global brand.

- A vibrant workplace: Work from Gallup’s San Francisco office in the heart of the Financial District, steps from the Embarcadero and public transit.

Our teams produce great work together, inspire each other to deliver exceptional outcomes, grow their potential and celebrate each other along the way. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

To review Gallup’s Privacy Statement, please click this link: https://www.gallup.com/privacy. This privacy policy is meant to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can update, manage and delete your information. Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.

Overview:
Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) offers internship and co-op opportunities to high-performing college students who want meaningful hands-on experiences in their fields of study. The following core values guide Marathon Petroleum’s approach to doing business: safety and environmental stewardship; integrity; inclusion; collaboration; and excellence. Interns/co-ops work side-by-side with experienced professionals as contributing members of diverse work teams who create value for the company’s shareholders. Marathon Petroleum believes that how we conduct our business is just as important as the bottom line.

As part of MPLX, a midstream company majority owned by MPC, the Natural Gas & Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Services organization is committed to delivering innovative solutions using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to support strategic decision-making. We are currently seeking a motivated and detail-oriented GIS Intern to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to gain hands-on experience and develop their skills in the rapidly evolving field of GIS.

As a GIS Intern, you will work alongside experienced GIS professionals and contribute to various projects involving data collection, analysis, and mapping. You will gain valuable experience working with GIS software, managing spatial data, and supporting key initiatives that leverage geospatial information.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assist in the collection, processing, and management of geospatial data using GIS software (e.g., ArcGIS).
- Support the creation and maintenance of maps, spatial data layers, and other GIS-related deliverables.
- Help perform spatial analysis and generate reports to support decision-making.
- Conduct data quality control and ensure data accuracy and consistency.
- Participate in field data collection activities (if applicable).
- Assist with data visualization and presenting geospatial data in accessible formats.
- Support GIS-related tasks for ongoing projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
- Provide technical support to team members and troubleshoot GIS-related issues.
- Stay up to date with emerging trends and technologies in GIS.

Qualifications:

- Candidates must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Geography, Geospatial Sciences, Urban Planning, Environmental Science, or a related field.
- Concurrent enrollment in a Bachelor's degree seeking program for the duration of the experience.
- Strong academic performance.
- Available to work on site 40 hours per week.
- Valid driver's license for work-related travel.
- Must be able to provide reliable transportation to and from place of work.
- Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.
- Familiarity with GIS software (ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar) and geospatial data formats.
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Excellent communication and organizational skills.
- Basic knowledge of spatial analysis, cartography, and data management practices is a plus.
- Previous experience in GIS (internships, coursework, or projects) is preferred.

Why apply?

- Gain hands-on experience working with GIS tools and technologies.
- Opportunity to contribute to real-world midstream projects and impact decision-making.
- Mentorship and guidance from experienced GIS professionals.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Data Analytics

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$28.00 - $30.00

Target Openings

4

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in early-mid September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

At Travelers, our vision is to advance our ability to fuel analytic-driven business decisions by accelerating cross-enterprise collaboration and capabilities. The Business Insights & Analytics Leadership Development Program (BI&ALDP) internship is built for analytically driven students who are serious about launching a career in data and analytics. This is not a passive, observational internship — you will do real work, solve real business problems, and be evaluated like a professional from day one.

Over 10 weeks, you and your cohort of peers will be embedded in Travelers' data and analytics community, gaining hands-on experience in one or more of our core analytics disciplines while building the technical and professional skills that define a successful career.

Technical training is delivered to you by current full-time BI&ALDP participants — those who were recently in your position — giving you an authentic, peer-informed perspective on what it takes to grow here.

Housing: The internship program is based in Hartford, CT and St. Paul, MN. Positions are available in our business units and corporate departments. Subsidized apartments are available for students who live beyond a commutable distance from Hartford, CT or St. Paul, MN.

Positions are available from June through early August.

What Will You Do?

- Real project work aligned to active business needs across Travelers' analytics functions.
- Technical training taught by full-time BI&ALDP participants.
- Formal performance reviews that give you honest, structured feedback on your growth.
- Leadership exposure through company-wide events including the Intern Symposium and community outreach initiatives, where you will interact with leaders and a cohort across the enterprise.
- A collaborative capstone presentation where you and your fellow interns develop and present solutions to relevant business and analytics challenges.
- Leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
- At the close of the internship, top-performing interns are eligible to interview for a full-time offer to join the BI&ALDP — making these 10 weeks one of the most important career opportunities of your academic journey.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

- Cumulative GPA of 3.2 or greater preferred.
- Obtained or pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science or Geography.
- Exposure to ESRI ArcGIS Pro and other GIS mapping software and platforms.
- Comfortable with using Python.
- Experience with spatial statistics, including working knowledge of map projects and coordinate system variations.
- Data warehouse and ETL understanding with Python, SQL, and/or Snowflake.
- Knowledge of data lakes and/or experience with Databricks a plus.

What is a Must Have?

- Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Make an Impact with Data Science

Bring your curiosity, technical skills, and bold ideas to Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group. Our Data Science Center of Expertise internship is a foundational development opportunity for emerging data science professionals ready to apply advanced analytics to meaningful healthcare challenges. You will contribute to strategically important work, learn alongside compassionate experts, and explore how innovative solutions can improve health outcomes and business decisions.

This is more than a summer project. Intern-developed solutions have evolved into enterprise capabilities, been presented to senior leadership, and, in several cases, contributed to patented innovations. You will also build relationships through professional development, networking, and direct engagement with senior data science leaders and clinical stakeholders who use analytics to shape strategic and operational decisions.

Responsibilities

- Develop and evaluate predictive, machine learning, natural language processing, or generative AI solutions that address complex healthcare and business challenges.

- Translate large, varied datasets, including claims, member information, call transcripts, surveys, and web logs, into insights that can improve member outcomes, experiences, and operational effectiveness.

- Partner with data scientists, engineers, business leaders, and clinical stakeholders to define problems, test ideas, and turn research into scalable solutions.

- Build clear, reproducible data pipelines, models, and visualizations using tools such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, or related technologies.

- Communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, including opportunities to present work to senior leadership.

- Apply a responsible, growth-oriented approach by seeking feedback, testing assumptions, documenting methods, and considering data quality, privacy, fairness, and model performance.

Past projects have included predictive models to improve member health outcomes; real-time NLP platforms that categorize member feedback; conversational AI solutions; transformer-based models for call topic classification; and research using optical character recognition and large language models to extract clinical entities from physician fax documents.

Required Qualifications

- Pursuing a master's degree or PhD in data science, statistics, applied mathematics, computer science, bioinformatics, computational linguistics, or another quantitative field.

- At least 1 year of hands-on data science or analytics experience gained through coursework, research, internships, or professional projects.

- Working knowledge of Python or R, probability and statistics, and data preparation, cleansing, and interpretation.

- Experience developing or evaluating analytical methods such as regression, decision trees, clustering, machine learning, text mining, or natural language processing.

- Ability to explain technical work clearly, collaborate across disciplines, and adapt based on feedback and new information.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience querying relational or distributed datasets using SQL, Hive SQL, Spark, PySpark, Scala, Hadoop, or HDFS.

- Experience with visualization tools or libraries such as Tableau, Shiny, ggplot, or Matplotlib.

- Demonstrated interest in healthcare analytics, responsible AI, experimentation, or translating research into practical solutions.

Additional Information

- Location: Interns are expected to work a hybrid schedule, spending three days per week in our Morris Plains, NJ, Austin, TX, or St. Louis, MO office and two days working remotely.

- Compensation: Hourly pay ranges from $35.00-$43.00, based on degree program, and year of study.

- Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and not require current or future employment sponsorship.

- Enterprise Intern Schedule: This is a full-time summer internship (40 hours per week) running from May 24 through August 13th

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

The OT Data Management team, located in Kennesaw, Georgia, is seeking an Analytics & Data Consumption Coop. This role will help transform validated OT data into actionable insights through analytical models, standardized KPIs, operational benchmarking, dashboards, and scalable data products. The coop’s primary project will focus on developing and evaluating AI-enabled insights on top of trusted OT datasets in Databricks, with attention to business relevance, data quality, traceability, and clear communication of results.

- Support the development, testing, and validation of AI-enabled insights using validated OT data in Databricks.

- Develop and validate analytical models, business rules, and standardized KPI calculations.

- Evaluate AI-generated findings against source data, established KPIs, and operational context to improve reliability and usefulness.

- Create or enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, and other data-consumption solutions for business stakeholders.

- Perform data quality assessments and document issues, assumptions, validation results, and recommended actions.

- Support cross-plant benchmarking and operational performance analytics.

- Contribute Python and Databricks development under the guidance of OT Data Management team members.

- Document analytical methodologies, dataset lineage, model logic, and user guidance to promote reuse and adoption.

- Support value-tracking activities by connecting analytical outputs to measurable operational opportunities.

Minimum qualifications

- Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.

- Foundational experience with Python and SQL for data preparation, analysis, or model development.

- Ability to analyze data, investigate inconsistencies, and communicate findings clearly.

- Interest in manufacturing, operational technology data, industrial analytics, or digital transformation.

- Ability to work collaboratively, manage assigned tasks, and document work in a structured and reproducible manner.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, or cloud-based data platforms.

- Experience developing Power BI reports, semantic models, or data visualizations.

- Exposure to machine learning, generative AI, natural-language interfaces, or AI-assisted analytics.

- Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality testing, KPI validation, or analytical model testing.

- Experience with Git or other version-control and collaborative development practices.

- Knowledge of manufacturing processes, time-series data, or operational performance metrics.

- Strong written communication skills and an interest in translating technical analysis into business insights.

Novelis’ Global Research and Technology Center located in Kennesaw Georgia within the greater Atlanta metropolitan area is a cutting-edge full-service research and technology hub that employs approximately 200 people including world-class engineers metallurgists chemists scientists technologists and technicians. Responsibilities

Our Business Integrity team has a strong user focus and a dedication to technical excellence. We aim to meet our users' needs with reliable and high-performing platforms and services. We are looking for strong machine learning engineers who are excited to grow their business understanding, build highly scalable machine learning models, and partner across disciplines with global teams, in pursuit of excellence. Given the fast growth of TikTok in the world, we are working on building a next-generation content understanding system for TikTok monetization. We are seeking Research Engineers who are experienced in machine learning, which can help us create an ecosystem that rewards high-quality user experience and advertiser value.

Topic Content: With the explosive growth of digital content, intelligent moderation has become a core capability for internet platforms. However, as moderation scenarios grow increasingly complex and adversarial tactics continue to evolve, traditional approaches are facing unprecedented challenges. The current landscape is characterized by multiple technical difficulties, including the dynamic nature of moderation rules, content complexity, sample scarcity, escalating adversarial behaviors, and a lack of interpretability. In particular, existing open-source large models often do not perform as effective as we expect in scenarios involving evolving moderation rules, long-form text, long temporal sequences, multi-languages, limited sample data, and adversarial content generated by AIGC.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. PhD internships at Our Company provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, as well as to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies.

Our dynamic internship experience blends hands-on learning, enriching community-building and professional development events, and collaboration with industry experts.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume (Start date, End date).

Responsibilities:
In this role, you will build a leading moderation system that enables end-to-end capabilities for accurate rejection decisions, interpretable reasoning, and intelligent remediation, achieving fully automated moderation with performance surpassing human benchmarks.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Automation, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical discipline (completed, or expecting to graduate within 12 months).
- Research experience in one or more of the following areas — Ads, Search, Recommender Systems, NLP, CV, Multimodal, or Agent technologies — demonstrated through publications, thesis work, internships, or research projects.
- Solid understanding of large language model methodology, including pre-training, post-training/alignment, and evaluation, with the ability to read, reproduce, and critique recent literature.
- Ability to independently formulate a research problem, design controlled experiments, and draw sound conclusions from ambiguous results.
- Proficient in Python and at least one deep learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Strong problem-solving ability, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in translating research into real-world products.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Publications at top-tier venues (ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, TPAMI), or equivalent evidence of research ability.
- Experience with RLHF / post-training, reasoning, or novel model architecture design.
- Experience designing evaluation benchmarks or LLM/VLM-as-Judge methodologies.
- Experience building agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or multimodal applications.
- Track record of research that shipped into a production system.
